ops.title: captain-hook Phase B: consume cc-transcript v14.6.0 command primitives (dual-mode Command + regex elimination + nested-payload rewrite)
ops.description:
Phase B of the approved plan `plans/our-hook-tha-tblocks-twinkling-tower.md`. Phase A shipped as cc-transcript **v14.6.0** (main a83aaf4, PyPI live) — the primitives exist; Phase B consumes them in captain-hook. **Full handoff:** cc-notes doc "captain-hook Phase B handoff — consume cc-transcript v14.6.0 command primitives" (read it first — has the consumer API, plan deltas, and start-here). Pin is `>=14.6` (NOT 14.3). Lanes: codex down til Jul 26, fable at limit → run on opus if still down.

B1 pin bump + baseline; B2 dual-mode Command (structural_argv predicate + _runs_structurally + nesting==0 regex pin + mode-audit test); B3 delete SAFE_WORD/SHELL_C_FLAG/unescape_shell/plain_words/emit_token/nested_command_string/descend_rm + nested-payload rewrite via splice/quote_for/embeddable + walker scope-aware cwd threading + to=/block_if nesting==0 filter; B4 _lib.py thinning; B5 review + ship (pack + tag).

ops.text: captain-hook pinned to cc-transcript[judge]>=14.6,<15 with the suite green on real v14.6.0
Command condition is dual-mode (plain-word structural via Word/unwrapped, regex-flavored via re.search pinned to nesting==0) with a mode-audit test freezing every in-repo pattern's mode
SAFE_WORD/SHELL_C_FLAG/unescape_shell/plain_words/emit_token/nested_command_string/descend_rm deleted; rm-guard rebuilt on Word.value/quote_for/embeddable + payload occurrences; glob.translate kept
nested bash -c/eval risky rm is REWRITTEN to trash and re-spliced (not just blocked), with forfeit-to-block on tainted/quote-context-impossible/span-less/depth
to= form and block_if filter to occ.nesting==0 (byte-identity preserved for the 9 cc-context to= consumers, proven by a regression test)
full pytest + capt-hook test + live probes + docs build green; captain-hook pack version bumped and released
